def parse_legacy_ine(raw_data: list) -> dict:
    data = {}
    for serie in raw_data:
        nombre = serie.get("Nombre", "")
        if "Flujo de inmigraciones" in nombre and "Total Nacional" in nombre and not "Español" in nombre and not "Extranjero" in nombre:
            parts = [p.strip() for p in nombre.split(".")]
            c = parts[-1] if parts[-1] else parts[-2]
            if c:
                if c not in data:
                    data[c] = {}
                for d in serie.get("Data", []):
                    if d.get("Valor") is not None:
                        y = str(d["Anyo"])
                        if int(y) <= 2020:
                            data[c][y] = int(round(float(d["Valor"])))
    return data


def parse_modern_ine(raw_data: list) -> dict:
    data = {}
    for serie in raw_data:
        meta = serie.get("MetaData", [])
        es_ambos = any(m.get("Nombre") == "Ambos sexos" for m in meta)
        es_nac_tot = any(m.get("T3_Variable") == "Nacionalidad" and m.get("Nombre") == "Total" for m in meta)
        if es_ambos and es_nac_tot:
            geo_name = None
            for m in meta:
                if m.get("T3_Variable") in ("Total Nacional", "Países y Continentes", "País de procedencia", "País de nacimiento"):
                    geo_name = m.get("Nombre", "").strip()
                    break
            if geo_name:
                if geo_name not in data:
                    data[geo_name] = {}
                for d in serie.get("Data", []):
                    if d.get("Valor") is not None:
                        y = str(d["Anyo"])
                        if int(y) >= 2021:
                            data[geo_name][y] = int(round(float(d["Valor"])))
    return data


def build_consolidated_dataset(raw_legacy: list, raw_modern: list) -> dict:
    print("\n[2/4] 📊 Procesando y reconciliando datos por país individual (2008-2024)...")
    d_leg = parse_legacy_ine(raw_legacy)
    d_mod = parse_modern_ine(raw_modern)

    all_years = [str(y) for y in range(2008, 2025)]

    data_points = []
    continents_points = []
    annual_blocks = []

    blocks_dict = {
        "america-hispanohablante": {"id": "america-hispanohablante", "name": BLOCK_NAMES["america-hispanohablante"], "color": BLOCK_COLORS["america-hispanohablante"], "countries": []},
        "america-no-hispanohablante": {"id": "america-no-hispanohablante", "name": BLOCK_NAMES["america-no-hispanohablante"], "color": BLOCK_COLORS["america-no-hispanohablante"], "countries": []},
        "europa": {"id": "europa", "name": BLOCK_NAMES["europa"], "color": BLOCK_COLORS["europa"], "countries": []},
        "africa": {"id": "africa", "name": BLOCK_NAMES["africa"], "color": BLOCK_COLORS["africa"], "countries": []},
        "asia": {"id": "asia", "name": BLOCK_NAMES["asia"], "color": BLOCK_COLORS["asia"], "countries": []},
        "oceania": {"id": "oceania", "name": BLOCK_NAMES["oceania"], "color": BLOCK_COLORS["oceania"], "countries": []},
    }

    seen_countries = set()
    for country_name, block_id in COUNTRY_BLOCK_MAP.items():
        c_id = slugify(country_name)
        if c_id not in seen_countries:
            seen_countries.add(c_id)
            blocks_dict[block_id]["countries"].append({"id": c_id, "name": country_name})

    blocks_def = list(blocks_dict.values())

    for y in all_years:
        d = d_leg if int(y) <= 2020 else d_mod
        tot_global = d.get("Total", {}).get(y, 0)

        block_values = {}
        continent_totals = {b_id: 0 for b_id in blocks_dict.keys()}
        country_values_flat = [{"total": tot_global}]

        for b_id, b_info in blocks_dict.items():
            b_countries_dict = {}
            b_sum = 0
            for c_info in b_info["countries"]:
                c_name = c_info["name"]
                c_id = c_info["id"]
                val = d.get(c_name, {}).get(y, 0)
                b_countries_dict[c_id] = val
                b_sum += val
                country_values_flat.append({c_id: val})

            continent_totals[b_id] = b_sum
            block_values[b_id] = {
                "total": b_sum,
                "countries": b_countries_dict
            }

        calculated_global = sum(continent_totals.values())
        if tot_global == 0 and calculated_global > 0:
            tot_global = calculated_global
            country_values_flat[0] = {"total": tot_global}

        annual_blocks.append({
            "year": y,
            "total": tot_global,
            "blocks": block_values,
        })

        continents_points.append({
            "year": y,
            "value": [{"total": tot_global}] + [{b_id: continent_totals[b_id]} for b_id in blocks_dict.keys()]
        })

        data_points.append({"year": y, "value": country_values_flat})

    today_str = date.today().isoformat()

    return {
        "id": "inmigracion-procedencia",
        "kind": "immigration-flow",
        "category": "pensions-demography",
        "valueFormat": "number",
        "blocks": blocks_def,
        "annualBlocks": annual_blocks,
        "dataPoints": data_points,
        "continentsDataPoints": continents_points,
        "contextNotes": [
            "Flujo anual total de inmigraciones procedentes del extranjero (ambos sexos) desde 2008 hasta 2024, enlazando la Estadística de Migraciones (2008-2020) y la EMCR (2021-2024) del INE.",
            "Agrupación en bloques continentales/lingüísticos con desglose de todos los países individuales procedentes de fuentes oficiales, sin agrupaciones artificiales en 'Resto de...'.",
        ],
        "sources": [
            {
                "institution": "Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE)",
                "title": "Estadística de Migraciones y Cambios de Residencia (EMCR)",
                "tableId": "69690",
                "period": "2021-2024",
                "lastUpdated": "2024-12-01",
                "url": "https://www.ine.es/jaxiT3/Tabla.htm?t=69690",
            },
            {
                "institution": "Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE)",
                "title": "Estadística de Migraciones (Serie histórica)",
                "tableId": "24295",
                "period": "2008-2020",
                "lastUpdated": "2021-12-01",
                "url": "https://www.ine.es/jaxiT3/Tabla.htm?t=24295",
            },
        ],
        "last_updated": today_str,
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raw_legacy = fetch_ine_table(INE_LEGACY_TABLE_ID, tip="A")
    raw_modern = fetch_ine_table(INE_MODERN_TABLE_ID, tip="AM")

    card = build_consolidated_dataset(raw_legacy, raw_modern)

    success = validate_and_stage(card)
    if success:
        promote_to_data(prefix_filter="inmigracion-procedencia")
        print("\n✨ ¡Proceso completado con éxito para inmigracion-procedencia sin agrupar en 'Resto de...'!")

--- FILE: backend/indicadores_nacionalidad.py ---
"""
Pipeline de Ingesta y Reconciliación: Indicadores Medidos por Nacionalidad en España.
Extrae estadísticas oficiales del INE remitidas a Eurostat (Padrón/ECP, EPA, ECV, Adquisiciones)
aplicando neutralidad estricta y trazabilidad directa.
"""

import argparse
from datetime import date
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
from typing import Any, Optional

from eurostat_client import fetch_eurostat_dataset, EurostatDataset
from utils import publish_dataset

GROUP_CODE_MAP = {
    "TOTAL": "total",
    "NAT": "nationals",
    "FOR": "foreigners",
    "FOR_STLS": "foreigners",
    "EU27_2020_FOR": "euForeigners",
    "NEU27_2020_FOR": "nonEuForeigners",
}


def load_json(path: Path) -> dict:
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)


def validate_concept_guide(guide: dict) -> None:
    if not guide.get("title") or not isinstance(guide["title"], str):
        raise ValueError("conceptGuide.title must be a non-empty string.")
    categories = {c["id"] for c in guide.get("categories", [])}
    if not categories:
        raise ValueError("conceptGuide.categories must not be empty.")

    terms = guide.get("terms", [])
    if not terms or not isinstance(terms, list):
        raise ValueError("conceptGuide.terms must be a non-empty list.")

    seen_codes = set()
    for term in terms:
        code = term.get("code")
        if not code or code in seen_codes:
            raise ValueError(f"Código de concepto duplicado o inválido en guía: {code}")
        seen_codes.add(code)
        cat_id = term.get("categoryId")
        if cat_id not in categories:
            raise ValueError(f"Categoría inválida '{cat_id}' en término '{code}'")

    for term in terms:
        for rel in term.get("relatedCodes", []):
            if rel not in seen_codes:
                raise ValueError(f"relatedCode '{rel}' en término '{term.get('code')}' no existe en terms.")


def build_nationality_indicators_payload(
    config: dict,
    datasets: dict[str, EurostatDataset],
    guide: Optional[dict] = None,
) -> dict:
    """
    Transforma, pivota y valida los datasets de Eurostat para producir el contrato
    canónico de NationalityIndicatorsItem.
    """
    start_year = int(config.get("startYear", 2008))

    ds_pop_ctz = datasets.get("popByCitizenship")
    ds_pop_birth = datasets.get("popByBirth")
    ds_acq = datasets.get("naturalizations")
    ds_emp_ctz = datasets.get("employedByCitizenship")
    ds_emp_birth = datasets.get("employedByBirth")
    ds_act_ctz = datasets.get("activityRateByCitizenship")
    ds_act_birth = datasets.get("activityRateByBirth")
    ds_empr_ctz = datasets.get("employmentRateByCitizenship")
    ds_empr_birth = datasets.get("employmentRateByBirth")
    ds_unemp_ctz = datasets.get("unemploymentRateByCitizenship")
    ds_unemp_birth = datasets.get("unemploymentRateByBirth")
    ds_inc_ctz = datasets.get("incomeByCitizenship")
    ds_inc_tot = datasets.get("incomeTotal")
    ds_pov_ctz = datasets.get("povertyRateByCitizenship")
    ds_pov_tot = datasets.get("povertyRateTotal")

    if not ds_pop_ctz or not ds_pop_birth:
        raise ValueError("Los datasets demográficos básicos (popByCitizenship, popByBirth) son obligatorios.")

    pop_ctz_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str, str], float] = {}
    for r in ds_pop_ctz.records:
        t = str(r.get("time"))
        c = r.get("citizen")
        a = r.get("age")
        v = r.get("value")
        if t and c and a and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
            pop_ctz_lookup[(t, c, a)] = float(v)

    pop_birth_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str, str], float] = {}
    for r in ds_pop_birth.records:
        t = str(r.get("time"))
        cb = r.get("c_birth")
        a = r.get("age")
        v = r.get("value")
        if t and cb and a and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
            pop_birth_lookup[(t, cb, a)] = float(v)

    acq_lookup: dict[str, int] = {}
    if ds_acq:
        for r in ds_acq.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                acq_lookup[t] = int(round(float(v)))

    emp_ctz_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
    if ds_emp_ctz:
        for r in ds_emp_ctz.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            c = r.get("citizen")
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and c and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                emp_ctz_lookup[(t, c)] = float(v)

    act_ctz_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
    if ds_act_ctz:
        for r in ds_act_ctz.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            c = r.get("citizen")
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and c and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                act_ctz_lookup[(t, c)] = float(v)

    empr_ctz_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
    if ds_empr_ctz:
        for r in ds_empr_ctz.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            c = r.get("citizen")
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and c and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                empr_ctz_lookup[(t, c)] = float(v)

    unemp_ctz_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
    if ds_unemp_ctz:
        for r in ds_unemp_ctz.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            c = r.get("citizen")
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and c and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                unemp_ctz_lookup[(t, c)] = float(v)

    emp_birth_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
    if ds_emp_birth:
        for r in ds_emp_birth.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            cb = r.get("c_birth")
            v = r.get("value")
            wstatus = r.get("wstatus")
            if wstatus and wstatus != "EMP":
                continue
            if t and cb and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                emp_birth_lookup[(t, cb)] = float(v)

    act_birth_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
    if ds_act_birth:
        for r in ds_act_birth.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            cb = r.get("c_birth")
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and cb and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                act_birth_lookup[(t, cb)] = float(v)

    empr_birth_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
    if ds_empr_birth:
        for r in ds_empr_birth.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            cb = r.get("c_birth")
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and cb and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                empr_birth_lookup[(t, cb)] = float(v)

    unemp_birth_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
    if ds_unemp_birth:
        for r in ds_unemp_birth.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            cb = r.get("c_birth")
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and cb and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                unemp_birth_lookup[(t, cb)] = float(v)

    inc_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str, str], float] = {}
    if ds_inc_ctz:
        for r in ds_inc_ctz.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            c = r.get("citizen") or r.get("c_citizen")
            stat = r.get("statinfo") or r.get("indic_il")
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and c and stat and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                m_key = "MED" if "MED" in stat else "MEAN"
                inc_lookup[(t, c, m_key)] = float(v)

    if ds_inc_tot:
        for r in ds_inc_tot.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            stat = r.get("statinfo") or r.get("indic_il")
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and stat and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                m_key = "MED" if "MED" in stat else "MEAN"
                inc_lookup[(t, "TOTAL", m_key)] = float(v)

    pov_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
    if ds_pov_ctz:
        for r in ds_pov_ctz.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            c = r.get("citizen") or r.get("c_citizen")
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and c and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                pov_lookup[(t, c)] = float(v)

    if ds_pov_tot:
        for r in ds_pov_tot.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                pov_lookup[(t, "TOTAL")] = float(v)

    all_years = set()
    for (t, c, a), _ in pop_ctz_lookup.items():
        try:
            y_int = int(t)
            if y_int >= start_year and a == "TOTAL":
                all_years.add(t)
        except ValueError:
            continue

    valid_years = []
    for y in sorted(all_years, key=int):
        has_total = (y, "TOTAL", "TOTAL") in pop_ctz_lookup
        has_nat = (y, "NAT", "TOTAL") in pop_ctz_lookup
        has_for = (y, "FOR", "TOTAL") in pop_ctz_lookup or (y, "FOR_STLS", "TOTAL") in pop_ctz_lookup
        if has_total and has_nat and has_for:
            valid_years.append(y)

    if len(valid_years) < 10:
        raise ValueError(f"Se encontraron solo {len(valid_years)} años válidos (mínimo 10 requeridos desde {start_year}).")

    annual_records = []
    top_level_datapoints = []

    def get_pop_stat(lookup: dict, y: str, code: str, age: str) -> Optional[float]:
        if (y, code, age) in lookup:
            return lookup[(y, code, age)]
        if code == "FOR" and (y, "FOR_STLS", age) in lookup:
            return lookup[(y, "FOR_STLS", age)]
        return None

    for y in valid_years:
        def_slices = {}

        for def_key, lookup, map_param in [
            ("citizenship", pop_ctz_lookup, "citizen"),
            ("birthplace", pop_birth_lookup, "c_birth"),
        ]:
            total_pop = get_pop_stat(lookup, y, "TOTAL", "TOTAL")
            total_working_age = get_pop_stat(lookup, y, "TOTAL", "Y15-64")

            if total_pop is None or total_pop <= 0 or total_working_age is None or total_working_age <= 0:
                demo_block = None
            else:
                demo_block = {}
                target_groups = [
                    ("total", "TOTAL"),
                    ("nationals", "NAT"),
                    ("foreigners", "FOR"),
                    ("euForeigners", "EU27_2020_FOR"),
                    ("nonEuForeigners", "NEU27_2020_FOR"),
                ]

                for gkey, ecode in target_groups:
                    pop = get_pop_stat(lookup, y, ecode, "TOTAL")
                    u15 = get_pop_stat(lookup, y, ecode, "Y_LT15")
                    w15_64 = get_pop_stat(lookup, y, ecode, "Y15-64")
                    s65 = get_pop_stat(lookup, y, ecode, "Y_GE65")

                    if pop is not None and u15 is not None and w15_64 is not None and s65 is not None:
                        share_total = round((pop / total_pop) * 100.0, 2)
                        share_work = round((w15_64 / total_working_age) * 100.0, 2)
                        u15_pct = round((u15 / pop) * 100.0, 2) if pop > 0 else 0.0
                        w15_64_pct = round((w15_64 / pop) * 100.0, 2) if pop > 0 else 0.0
                        s65_pct = round((s65 / pop) * 100.0, 2) if pop > 0 else 0.0
                        dep_ratio = round((s65 / w15_64) * 100.0, 1) if w15_64 > 0 else 0.0

                        demo_block[gkey] = {
                            "population": int(round(pop)),
                            "shareOfTotalPct": share_total,
                            "shareOfWorkingAgePct": share_work,
                            "oldAgeDependencyRatio": dep_ratio,
                            "ageBands": {
                                "under15": int(round(u15)),
                                "workingAge15to64": int(round(w15_64)),
                                "senior65plus": int(round(s65)),
                                "under15Pct": u15_pct,
                                "workingAge15to64Pct": w15_64_pct,
                                "senior65plusPct": s65_pct,
                            },
                        }
                    elif gkey in ("total", "nationals", "foreigners"):
                        demo_block = None
                        break

            if def_key == "citizenship":
                emp_lk = emp_ctz_lookup
                act_lk = act_ctz_lookup
                empr_lk = empr_ctz_lookup
                unemp_lk = unemp_ctz_lookup
            else:
                emp_lk = emp_birth_lookup
                act_lk = act_birth_lookup
                empr_lk = empr_birth_lookup
                unemp_lk = unemp_birth_lookup

            total_emp = emp_lk.get((y, "TOTAL"))
            has_any_labor = any(
                (y, code) in lk
                for lk in (emp_lk, act_lk, empr_lk, unemp_lk)
                for code in ("TOTAL", "NAT", "FOR")
            )

            if not has_any_labor:
                labor_block = None
            else:
                labor_block = {}
                target_labor_groups = [
                    ("total", "TOTAL"),
                    ("nationals", "NAT"),
                    ("foreigners", "FOR"),
                    ("euForeigners", "EU27_2020_FOR"),
                    ("nonEuForeigners", "NEU27_2020_FOR"),
                ]
                for gkey, ecode in target_labor_groups:
                    emp_val = emp_lk.get((y, ecode))
                    act_val = act_lk.get((y, ecode))
                    empr_val = empr_lk.get((y, ecode))
                    unemp_val = unemp_lk.get((y, ecode))

                    share_emp = None
                    if emp_val is not None and total_emp is not None and total_emp > 0:
                        share_emp = round((emp_val / total_emp) * 100.0, 2)

                    if any(v is not None for v in (emp_val, act_val, empr_val, unemp_val)):
                        labor_block[gkey] = {
                            "employedThousands": round(emp_val, 1) if emp_val is not None else None,
                            "shareOfEmployedPct": share_emp,
                            "activityRatePct": round(act_val, 1) if act_val is not None else None,
                            "employmentRatePct": round(empr_val, 1) if empr_val is not None else None,
                            "unemploymentRatePct": round(unemp_val, 1) if unemp_val is not None else None,
                        }

            def_slices[def_key] = {
                "demographics": demo_block,
                "laborMarket": labor_block,
            }

        has_any_income = any(
            (y, code, m) in inc_lookup
            for code in ("TOTAL", "NAT", "FOR")
            for m in ("MED", "MEAN")
        ) or any((y, code) in pov_lookup for code in ("TOTAL", "NAT", "FOR"))

        if not has_any_income:
            living_block = None
        else:
            living_block = {}
            target_income_groups = [
                ("total", "TOTAL"),
                ("nationals", "NAT"),
                ("foreigners", "FOR"),
                ("euForeigners", "EU27_2020_FOR"),
                ("nonEuForeigners", "NEU27_2020_FOR"),
            ]
            for gkey, ecode in target_income_groups:
                med_inc = inc_lookup.get((y, ecode, "MED"))
                mean_inc = inc_lookup.get((y, ecode, "MEAN"))
                pov_pct = pov_lookup.get((y, ecode))

                if any(v is not None for v in (med_inc, mean_inc, pov_pct)):
                    living_block[gkey] = {
                        "medianEquivalisedIncomeEur": round(med_inc, 1) if med_inc is not None else None,
                        "meanEquivalisedIncomeEur": round(mean_inc, 1) if mean_inc is not None else None,
                        "atRiskOfPovertyPct": round(pov_pct, 1) if pov_pct is not None else None,
                    }

        nat_val = acq_lookup.get(y)

        annual_records.append({
            "year": y,
            "naturalizations": nat_val,
            "definitions": def_slices,
            "livingConditions": living_block,
        })

        cit_demo = def_slices["citizenship"]["demographics"]
        if cit_demo and "foreigners" in cit_demo:
            top_level_datapoints.append({
                "year": y,
                "value": cit_demo["foreigners"]["shareOfTotalPct"],
            })

    if len(top_level_datapoints) < 10:
        raise ValueError(f"Se requieren al menos 10 dataPoints cronológicos (obtenidos {len(top_level_datapoints)}).")

    for rec in annual_records:
        y = rec["year"]
        for dkey in ["citizenship", "birthplace"]:
            demo = rec["definitions"][dkey]["demographics"]
            if demo:
                tot_p = demo["total"]["population"]
                nat_p = demo["nationals"]["population"]
                for_p = demo["foreigners"]["population"]
                diff_pop = abs((nat_p + for_p) - tot_p) / tot_p
                if diff_pop > 0.01:
                    raise ValueError(f"Fallo en identidad demográfica {dkey} año {y}: (NAT + FOR) != TOTAL ({diff_pop * 100:.2f}% de error)")

                for grp_k in ["total", "nationals", "foreigners"]:
                    if grp_k in demo:
                        bands = demo[grp_k]["ageBands"]
                        sum_pct = bands["under15Pct"] + bands["workingAge15to64Pct"] + bands["senior65plusPct"]
                        if abs(sum_pct - 100.0) > 0.5:
                            raise ValueError(f"Suma de porcentajes etarios inválida ({sum_pct:.2f}%) en {dkey} {grp_k} año {y}")

            labor = rec["definitions"][dkey]["laborMarket"]
            if labor:
                for grp_k, lstats in labor.items():
                    for rate_key in ["activityRatePct", "employmentRatePct", "unemploymentRatePct"]:
                        r_val = lstats.get(rate_key)
                        if r_val is not None:
                            if not math.isfinite(r_val) or r_val < 0.0 or r_val > 100.0:
                                raise ValueError(f"Tasa laboral corrupta o fuera de rango [0, 100]: {rate_key}={r_val} en {dkey} {grp_k} {y}")

        liv = rec["livingConditions"]
        if liv:
            for grp_k, istats in liv.items():
                for inc_key in ["medianEquivalisedIncomeEur", "meanEquivalisedIncomeEur"]:
                    i_val = istats.get(inc_key)
                    if i_val is not None:
                        if not math.isfinite(i_val) or i_val <= 0:
                            raise ValueError(f"Renta corrupta o negativa: {inc_key}={i_val} en {grp_k} {y}")
                p_val = istats.get("atRiskOfPovertyPct")
                if p_val is not None:
                    if not math.isfinite(p_val) or p_val < 0.0 or p_val > 100.0:
                        raise ValueError(f"Tasa de pobreza fuera de rango [0, 100]: {p_val} en {grp_k} {y}")

    output_sources = []
    all_updated = []
    for s in config.get("sources", []):
        s_keys = s.get("datasetKeys", [])
        updated_dates = [datasets[k].updated for k in s_keys if k in datasets and datasets[k].updated]
        all_updated.extend(updated_dates)
        last_upd = max(updated_dates, default=date.today().isoformat())
        output_sources.append({
            "institution": s["institution"],
            "shortName": s["shortName"],
            "title": s["title"],
            "tableId": s.get("tableId", ""),
            "period": f"{valid_years[0]}–{valid_years[-1]}",
            "lastUpdated": last_upd,
            "url": s["url"],
        })

    latest_global_update = max(all_updated, default=date.today().isoformat())

    payload = {
        "id": config["indicatorId"],
        "kind": config["chartType"],
        "category": config["category"],
        "valueFormat": "percent",
        "lastUpdated": latest_global_update,
        "dataPoints": top_level_datapoints,
        "annualRecords": annual_records,
        "contextNotes": [
            "Todos los indicadores proceden directamente de estadísticas oficiales del INE remitidas a Eurostat (Padrón/ECP, EPA, ECV y Estadística de Adquisiciones de Nacionalidad), sin imputaciones sintéticas ni multiplicadores estimados.",
            "La clasificación por nacionalidad (pasaporte) refleja el estatus legal en cada año; las adquisiciones anuales de nacionalidad española trasladan a residentes nacidos en el extranjero del grupo de población extranjera al de nacionalidad española.",
            "Los indicadores del mercado laboral (tasa de actividad, empleo, paro y ocupados) corresponden a la población de 15 a 64 años conforme a los criterios armonizados de la EPA / LFS.",
            "La renta neta equivalente (ECV / EU-SILC) ajusta los ingresos disponibles del hogar por su tamaño y composición mediante la escala modificada de la OCDE para comparar el poder adquisitivo individual."
        ],
        "sources": output_sources,
    }

    if guide:
        validate_concept_guide(guide)
        payload["conceptGuide"] = guide

    return payload


def run_pipeline(
    config_path: Path,
    guide_path: Optional[Path],
    output_path: Path,
    dry_run: bool = False,
) -> dict:
    config = load_json(config_path)
    guide = load_json(guide_path) if guide_path and guide_path.exists() else None

    base_url = config["apiBaseUrl"]
    datasets_cfg = config["datasets"]

    print(f"\n[1/3] 📥 Descargando datasets oficiales de Eurostat para {config['indicatorId']}...")
    datasets: dict[str, EurostatDataset] = {}

    for dkey, dinfo in datasets_cfg.items():
        code = dinfo["code"]
        params = dict(dinfo.get("params", {}))
        fallback_code = dinfo.get("fallbackCode")

        try:
            ds = fetch_eurostat_dataset(base_url, code, params, since_year=config.get("startYear", 2008))
            datasets[dkey] = ds
        except Exception as e:
            if fallback_code:
                print(f"      ⚠️ Query {code} falló ({e}). Intentando fallback {fallback_code}...")
                try:
                    ds = fetch_eurostat_dataset(base_url, fallback_code, params, since_year=config.get("startYear", 2008))
                    datasets[dkey] = ds
                    continue
                except Exception as e_fb:
                    print(f"      ❌ Fallback {fallback_code} también falló: {e_fb}")
            print(f"      ⚠️ Advertencia en dataset '{dkey}' ({code}): {e}")

    print("\n[2/3] ⚖️ Procesando, reconciliando y aplicando identidades estadísticas...")
    payload = build_nationality_indicators_payload(config, datasets, guide)

    if not dry_run:
        slug = config["indicatorId"]
        es_data = {
            "question": "Demografía, empleo y renta por nacionalidad y país de nacimiento.",
            "unit": config.get("headlineUnit", "% población extranjera"),
            "contextNotes": payload["contextNotes"],
            "sources": payload["sources"],
        }
        if "conceptGuide" in payload:
            es_data["conceptGuide"] = payload["conceptGuide"]

        en_data = {
            "question": "Demographics, employment, and income by nationality and country of birth.",
            "unit": "% foreign population",
            "contextNotes": [
                "All indicators trace directly to official statistics from Spain's INE transmitted to Eurostat (Padrón/ECP, EPA, ECV, and Acquisition of Citizenship Statistics).",
                "Citizenship breakdown reflects legal passport status in each year; annual acquisitions of Spanish citizenship transition foreign-born residents into Spanish national statistics.",
                "Labor market indicators (activity rate, employment rate, unemployment rate) cover ages 15-64 following harmonized EPA/LFS criteria.",
                "Equivalised net income (EU-SILC) adjusts household disposable income by size and composition using the modified OECD scale."
            ],
            "sources": payload["sources"],
        }
        if "conceptGuide" in payload:
            en_data["conceptGuide"] = payload["conceptGuide"]

        publish_dataset(slug, payload, es_data, en_data)

    return payload


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Pipeline de indicadores por nacionalidad (Factor.es)")
    parser.add_argument("--config", type=Path, default=Path("scrapers/config/indicadores_nacionalidad_sources.json"))
    parser.add_argument("--guide", type=Path, default=Path("scrapers/config/indicadores_nacionalidad_guide.json"))
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=Path("data/indicadores-nacionalidad-espana.json"))
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")

    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        run_pipeline(args.config, args.guide, args.output, dry_run=args.dry_run)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"\n❌ ERROR CRÍTICO EN PIPELINE DE NACIONALIDAD: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
Cliente HTTP dedicado a consultar las tablas de la API oficial del INE.
Responsabilidad única (SRP): Comunicación e integración con la API Tempus JS del INE.
"""

import json
import requests
from tqdm import tqdm

INE_API_BASE_URL = "https://servicios.ine.es/wstempus/js/ES/DATOS_TABLA"


def fetch_ine_table(table_id: str, tip: str = "AM", timeout: int = 60) -> list:
    """
    Consulta la API Tempus del INE para obtener los datos crudos de una tabla determinada,
    mostrando una barra de progreso en tiempo real con tqdm.
    """
    url = f"{INE_API_BASE_URL}/{table_id}?tip={tip}"
    print(f"\n[1/4] 🌐 Descargando datos desde la API del INE (Tabla {table_id})...")

    with requests.get(url, stream=True, timeout=timeout) as response:
        response.raise_for_status()
        total_size = int(response.headers.get("content-length", 0))
        chunk_size = 16384
        chunks = []

        with tqdm(
            total=total_size if total_size > 0 else None,
            unit="B",
            unit_scale=True,
            unit_divisor=1024,
            desc="      Descarga INE",
            ncols=80,
        ) as pbar:
            for chunk in response.iter_content(chunk_size=chunk_size):
                if chunk:
                    chunks.append(chunk)
                    pbar.update(len(chunk))

        raw_bytes = b"".join(chunks)
        print("      ⌛ Deserializando respuesta JSON...")
        try:
            data = json.loads(raw_bytes.decode("utf-8"))
        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Error deserializando JSON de la tabla INE {table_id}. "
                f"La respuesta fue truncada o es inválida ({len(raw_bytes)} bytes recibidos). "
                f"Detalle: {e}"
            ) from e
        print(f"      ✓ Respuesta recibida: {len(data)} series de datos crudas obtenidas.")
        return data

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Pipeline de Ingesta: Registros Administrativos por Nacionalidad en España (AEAT, TGSS e INE).
- Descubre automáticamente todos los años disponibles en las estadísticas tributarias de la AEAT
  (asalariados y desempleados por nacionalidad; pensionistas en total nacional).
- Consulta la serie completa de afiliados extranjeros de la TGSS (PX-Web).
- Descubre y consulta la Tabla 48951 del INE (Personas según situación en la Seguridad Social
  por nacionalidad) para obtener el número exacto de pensionistas contributivos españoles y extranjeros.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
from datetime import date, datetime
import io
import math
import re
import sys
import time
import traceback
from typing import Any
from urllib.parse import urljoin

from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import requests

)

)

)
TGSS_FALLBACK_CSV_URL = (
    "https://w6.seg-social.es/PXWeb/sq/"
    "5724c901-f5c9-42d8-9d13-26506ee6a261"
)
TGSS_PORTAL_URL = (
    "https://w6.seg-social.es/PXWeb/pxweb/es/Afiliados_extranjeros/"
    "Afiliados_extranjeros__Afiliados_extranjeros_ultimo_dia/"
)

INE_PENSIONERS_TABLE_ID = "48951"
INE_PENSIONERS_PORTAL_URL = "https://www.ine.es/jaxi/Tabla.htm?tpx=48951&L=0"
INE_PENSIONERS_DATA_URL = "https://www.ine.es/jaxi/Datos.htm?tpx=48951&L=0"

HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": "Factores-public-data-ingestion/2.6 (+https://factores.es)",
    "Accept": "text/html,text/csv,text/plain,application/json,*/*",
}
TIMEOUT = 45
RETRIES = 3

SEX_ALIASES = {
    "total": "total",
    "ambos sexos": "total",
    "ambos": "total",
    "varón": "male",
    "varon": "male",
    "hombre": "male",
    "hombres": "male",
    "mujer": "female",
    "mujeres": "female",
    "no consta": "unknown",
    "desconocido": "unknown",
}

NATIONALITY_ALIASES = {
    "total": "total",
    "total nacionalidad": "total",
    "española": "spanish",
    "espanola": "spanish",
    "español": "spanish",
    "nacionalidad española": "spanish",
    "extranjera": "foreign",
    "extranjero": "foreign",
    "nacionalidad extranjera": "foreign",
    "unión europea": "eu27",
    "union europea": "eu27",
    "resto de europa": "nonEu",
}

POPULATION_SPECS = {
    "asalariados": {
        "key": "salariedWorkers",
        "measures": ["headcount", "paymentsPerPerson", "totalWagesEur", "averageAnnualWageEur"],
    },
    "desempleados": {
        "key": "unemploymentRecipients",
        "measures": ["recipients", "averageBenefitEur"],
    },
    "desempleo": {
        "key": "unemploymentRecipients",
        "measures": ["recipients", "averageBenefitEur"],
    },
    "pensionistas": {
        "key": "pensionRecipients",
        "measures": ["recipients", "paymentsPerPerson", "averagePensionEur"],
    },
    "pensiones": {
        "key": "pensionRecipients",
        "measures": ["recipients", "paymentsPerPerson", "averagePensionEur"],
    },
}


def fetch(
    url: str,
    *,
    method: str = "GET",
    json_body: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    allow_404: bool = False,
) -> requests.Response | None:
    last_error: Exception | None = None
    for attempt in range(RETRIES):
        try:
            if method == "POST":
                response = requests.post(url, json=json_body, headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)
            else:
                response = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=TIMEOUT)

            if allow_404 and response.status_code == 404:
                return None

            if response.status_code in {429, 500, 502, 503, 504} and attempt < RETRIES - 1:
                time.sleep(2 ** attempt)
                continue

            response.raise_for_status()
            return response
        except requests.RequestException as exc:
            last_error = exc
            if attempt < RETRIES - 1:
                time.sleep(2 ** attempt)
            else:
                raise
    raise RuntimeError(f"Error conectando con {url}: {last_error}")


def normalized_label(value: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", value.replace("\xa0", " ")).strip()


def parse_number(value: str) -> int | float | None:
    raw = str(value).strip().replace("\xa0", " ")
    if raw in {"", "-", "—", "…", "..", ":", "n.d.", "nd"}:
        return None
    raw = raw.replace(" ", "")
    if "," in raw and "." in raw:
        if raw.rfind(",") > raw.rfind("."):
            raw = raw.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
        else:
            raw = raw.replace(",", "")
    elif "," in raw:
        raw = raw.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".")
    else:
        if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d{1,3}(\.\d{3})+", raw):
            raw = raw.replace(".", "")
    try:
        number = float(raw)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if not math.isfinite(number):
        return None
    return int(number) if number.is_integer() else round(number, 2)


def decode_text_bytes(content: bytes) -> str:
    for encoding in ("utf-8-sig", "cp1252", "latin-1"):
        try:
            return content.decode(encoding)
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            continue
    raise ValueError("No se pudo decodificar la respuesta textual de la fuente.")


def discover_aeat_edition_urls(start_year: int = START_YEAR) -> dict[str, list[tuple[str, str]]]:
    current_year = date.today().year
    discovered: dict[str, list[tuple[str, str]]] = {}
    exclude_words = [
        "comunidad",
        "provincia",
        "sector",
        "tramo",
        "pagador",
        "módulo",
        "modulo",
        "entidades",
        "ccaa",
        "centila",
        "decila",
    ]

    for year in range(start_year, current_year + 1):
        map_url = AEAT_MAP_URL_TEMPLATE.format(year=year)
        resp = fetch(map_url, allow_404=True)
        if resp is None:
            continue

        soup = BeautifulSoup(decode_text_bytes(resp.content), "html.parser")
        year_links: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
        seen_urls: set[str] = set()

        for anchor in soup.find_all("a", href=True):
            if anchor["href"].startswith("javascript"):
                continue
            label = normalized_label(anchor.get_text(" ", strip=True))
            label_cf = label.casefold()

            if any(w in label_cf for w in exclude_words):
                continue

            if (
                any(pop in label_cf for pop in ("asalariados", "desempleados", "pensionistas"))
                and "edad" in label_cf
                and "sexo" in label_cf
            ):
                candidate = urljoin(map_url, anchor["href"])
                if candidate not in seen_urls:
                    seen_urls.add(candidate)
                    year_links.append((candidate, label))

        if year_links:
            discovered[str(year)] = year_links

    return discovered


def _match_population_spec(
    soup: BeautifulSoup, link_label: str, table_header_text: str
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    title_text = normalized_label(soup.title.get_text(" ", strip=True)) if soup.title else ""
    headings_text = " ".join(
        normalized_label(h.get_text(" ", strip=True))
        for h in soup.find_all(["h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "caption"])
    )
    candidates = [link_label, title_text, headings_text, table_header_text]
    for candidate in candidates:
        cf = candidate.casefold()
        if "asalariad" in cf:
            return POPULATION_SPECS["asalariados"]
        if "desemplead" in cf or "desempleo" in cf:
            return POPULATION_SPECS["desempleados"]
        if "pensionist" in cf or "pensiones" in cf:
            return POPULATION_SPECS["pensionistas"]
    return None


def parse_aeat_page(
    url: str, html: str, link_label: str = ""
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[tuple[str, str]]]:
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
    page_text = normalized_label(soup.get_text(" ", strip=True))

    sibling_links: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    for a in soup.find_all("a", href=True):
        a_text = normalized_label(a.get_text(" ", strip=True))
        a_cf = a_text.casefold()
        if a_cf in {"española", "extranjera", "nacionalidad española", "nacionalidad extranjera"}:
            cand = urljoin(url, a["href"])
            if cand != url and not a["href"].startswith("javascript"):
                sibling_links.append((cand, f"{link_label} Nacionalidad: {a_text}"))

    year_match = re.search(r"Ejercicio\s+(20\d{2})", page_text, re.I) or re.search(r"/(20\d{2})/", url)
    if not year_match:
        return [], sibling_links
    year = year_match.group(1)

    page_nat_key: str | None = None
    lbl_cf = link_label.casefold()
    if "nacionalidad: española" in lbl_cf or "nacionalidad: espanola" in lbl_cf:
        page_nat_key = "spanish"
    elif "nacionalidad: extranjera" in lbl_cf:
        page_nat_key = "foreign"
    elif "nacionalidad: total" in lbl_cf:
        page_nat_key = "total"

    if not page_nat_key:
        heading = soup.find(
            lambda tag: tag.name in ["h2", "h3", "h4", "div", "p"]
            and "nacionalidad" in tag.get_text().lower()
        )
        if heading:
            txt = normalized_label(heading.get_text(" ", strip=True)).casefold()
            m = re.search(r"nacionalidad\s*:?\s*(total|española|espanola|extranjera)", txt)
            if m:
                page_nat_key = NATIONALITY_ALIASES.get(m.group(1))

    page_nat_key = page_nat_key or "total"

    extracted_blocks: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for table in soup.find_all("table"):
        parsed_rows: list[list[str]] = []
        for tr in table.find_all("tr"):
            cells = [normalized_label(c.get_text(" ", strip=True)) for c in tr.find_all(["th", "td"])]
            if cells:
                parsed_rows.append(cells)

        if len(parsed_rows) < 2:
            continue

        table_header_text = " ".join(" ".join(r) for r in parsed_rows[:5])
        matched_spec = _match_population_spec(soup, link_label, table_header_text)
        if not matched_spec:
            continue

        measure_names = matched_spec["measures"]
        n_meas = len(measure_names)
        pop_k = matched_spec["key"]

        sex_sections: dict[str, dict[str, dict[str, int | float]]] = {
            "total": {},
            "male": {},
            "female": {},
        }

        for row in parsed_rows:
            first_cell_cf = row[0].casefold()
            numeric_tail = [parse_number(v) for v in row[1:]]
            if all(v is None for v in numeric_tail):
                continue

            age_label = (
                "Total"
                if first_cell_cf == "esquina" or first_cell_cf.startswith("total")
                else row[0]
            )

            if len(row) >= 1 + 3 * n_meas:
                vals = [parse_number(v) for v in row[1 : 1 + 3 * n_meas]]
                if all(v is not None for v in vals):
                    for idx_sex, sex_code in enumerate(("total", "male", "female")):
                        chunk = vals[idx_sex * n_meas : (idx_sex + 1) * n_meas]
                        row_dict: dict[str, int | float | None] = {
                            m_name: chunk[i]
                            for i, m_name in enumerate(measure_names)
                        }
                        if pop_k == "unemploymentRecipients":
                            row_dict["totalBenefitsEur"] = round(row_dict["recipients"] * row_dict["averageBenefitEur"])  # type: ignore[operator]
                        elif pop_k == "pensionRecipients":
                            row_dict["totalPensionsEur"] = round(row_dict["recipients"] * row_dict["averagePensionEur"])  # type: ignore[operator]
                        sex_sections[sex_code][age_label] = row_dict  # type: ignore[assignment]
                    continue

            if len(row) >= 1 + n_meas:
                vals = [parse_number(v) for v in row[1 : 1 + n_meas]]
                if all(v is not None for v in vals):
                    row_dict = {
                        m_name: vals[i]
                        for i, m_name in enumerate(measure_names)
                    }
                    if pop_k == "unemploymentRecipients":
                        row_dict["totalBenefitsEur"] = round(row_dict["recipients"] * row_dict["averageBenefitEur"])  # type: ignore[operator]
                    elif pop_k == "pensionRecipients":
                        row_dict["totalPensionsEur"] = round(row_dict["recipients"] * row_dict["averagePensionEur"])  # type: ignore[operator]
                    sex_sections["total"][age_label] = row_dict  # type: ignore[assignment]

        for sex_code, age_bands in sex_sections.items():
            if "Total" in age_bands:
                extracted_blocks.append({
                    "year": year,
                    "populationKey": pop_k,
                    "nationalityKey": page_nat_key,
                    "sexKey": sex_code,
                    "ageBands": age_bands,
                    "url": url,
                })

        if extracted_blocks:
            break

    return extracted_blocks, sibling_links


def fetch_all_aeat_data() -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], list[str]]:
    print("\n[1/4] 🌐 Descubriendo y descargando ediciones anuales de la AEAT...")
    edition_links = discover_aeat_edition_urls(START_YEAR)
    if not edition_links:
        raise RuntimeError("No se encontraron ediciones anuales en el portal de la AEAT.")

    raw_by_year: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    urls_by_year: dict[str, list[str]] = {}

    for year in sorted(edition_links.keys(), key=int):
        year_bucket: dict[str, Any] = {}
        year_urls_used: list[str] = []
        queue = list(edition_links[year])
        visited: set[str] = set()

        while queue:
            url, link_label = queue.pop(0)
            if url in visited:
                continue
            visited.add(url)

            resp = fetch(url, allow_404=True)
            if resp is None:
                continue

            blocks, siblings = parse_aeat_page(url, decode_text_bytes(resp.content), link_label=link_label)
            for sib_url, sib_label in siblings:
                if sib_url not in visited:
                    queue.append((sib_url, sib_label))

            for parsed in blocks:
                pop_k = parsed["populationKey"]
                nat_k = parsed["nationalityKey"]
                sex_k = parsed["sexKey"]
                existing = year_bucket.setdefault(pop_k, {}).setdefault(nat_k, {}).get(sex_k, {})
                if len(parsed["ageBands"]) >= len(existing):
                    year_bucket[pop_k][nat_k][sex_k] = parsed["ageBands"]
                if url not in year_urls_used:
                    year_urls_used.append(url)

        # La AEAT no publica desglose por nacionalidad para pensionistas,
        # por lo que se conserva únicamente la clave 'total' sin duplicar importes.

        if year_bucket:
            raw_by_year[year] = year_bucket
            urls_by_year[year] = year_urls_used
            pops_found = ", ".join(sorted(year_bucket.keys()))
            nats_found = sorted({n for p in year_bucket.values() for n in p.keys()})
            print(f"      ✓ AEAT {year}: {len(year_urls_used)} páginas ({pops_found} | nacionalidades: {nats_found}).")
        else:
            print(f"      ⚠️ AEAT {year}: ninguna tabla coincidió con el esquema esperado.")

    if not raw_by_year:
        raise RuntimeError("Ningún año de la AEAT pudo ser extraído.")

    valid_pops_per_year: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    for year, bucket in raw_by_year.items():
        valid_pops = {
            pop_k
            for pop_k, nat_map in bucket.items()
            if (
                "spanish" in nat_map
                and "foreign" in nat_map
                and "total" in nat_map["spanish"]
                and "total" in nat_map["foreign"]
            )
            or (
                pop_k == "pensionRecipients"
                and "total" in nat_map
                and "total" in nat_map["total"]
            )
        }
        if valid_pops:
            valid_pops_per_year[year] = valid_pops

    if not valid_pops_per_year:
        raise RuntimeError("Ningún año de la AEAT contiene desglose válido por nacionalidad.")

    common_populations = set.intersection(*valid_pops_per_year.values())
    if not common_populations:
        all_pops = {p for pops in valid_pops_per_year.values() for p in pops}
        common_populations = {
            p for p in all_pops
            if sum(1 for pops in valid_pops_per_year.values() if p in pops) >= max(2, len(valid_pops_per_year) // 2)
        }

    by_year: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    used_urls: list[str] = []
    for year in sorted(valid_pops_per_year.keys(), key=int):
        if common_populations.issubset(valid_pops_per_year[year]):
            by_year[year] = {
                pop_k: raw_by_year[year][pop_k]
                for pop_k in sorted(common_populations)
            }
            used_urls.extend(urls_by_year[year])
        else:
            print(f"      ⚠️ AEAT {year}: omitido por no incluir todas las poblaciones comunes ({sorted(common_populations)}).")

    if not by_year:
        raise RuntimeError("Ningún año de la AEAT cumplió con la estructura común esperada.")

    return by_year, used_urls


def parse_ine_pensioners_csv(text: str) -> dict[str, dict[str, int]]:
    """
    Analiza el CSV semicolon-delimited de la Tabla 48951 del INE:
    'Personas según situación en la Seguridad Social por nacionalidad' (en miles).
    Suma las categorías con pensión contributiva:
      - 'Pensión contributiva de la Seguridad Social'
      - 'Alta laboral y pensión contributiva de la Seguridad Social'
    para el total poblacional ('Personas con y sin discapacidad' == 'Total').
    """
    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text), delimiter=";", quotechar='"'))
    if len(rows) < 2:
        raise ValueError("CSV de Tabla 48951 del INE vacío o demasiado corto.")

    headers = [normalized_label(c).casefold() for c in rows[0]]
    try:
        idx_nat = next(i for i, h in enumerate(headers) if "nacionalidad" in h)
        idx_sit = next(i for i, h in enumerate(headers) if "situaci" in h)
        idx_dis = next((i for i, h in enumerate(headers) if "discapacidad" in h), None)
        idx_per = next(i for i, h in enumerate(headers) if "periodo" in h or "año" in h)
        idx_val = next(i for i, h in enumerate(headers) if "total" in h or "valor" in h)
    except StopIteration as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"Columnas inesperadas en Tabla 48951 del INE: {rows[0]}") from exc

    accum: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}

    for row in rows[1:]:
        if len(row) <= max(idx_nat, idx_sit, idx_per, idx_val):
            continue

        if idx_dis is not None:
            dis_label = normalized_label(row[idx_dis]).casefold()
            if dis_label != "total":
                continue

        sit_label = normalized_label(row[idx_sit]).casefold()
        if "pensión contributiva" not in sit_label and "pension contributiva" not in sit_label:
            continue

        nat_label = normalized_label(row[idx_nat]).casefold()
        nat_key = NATIONALITY_ALIASES.get(nat_label)
        if nat_key not in {"total", "spanish", "foreign"}:
            continue

        period = normalized_label(row[idx_per])
        if not re.fullmatch(r"20\d{2}", period) or int(period) < START_YEAR:
            continue

        val_thousands = parse_number(row[idx_val])
        if val_thousands is None:
            continue

        accum.setdefault(period, {})
        accum[period][nat_key] = accum[period].get(nat_key, 0.0) + float(val_thousands)

    result: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
    for year, nat_vals in sorted(accum.items(), key=lambda kv: int(kv[0])):
        if {"total", "spanish", "foreign"}.issubset(nat_vals.keys()):
            result[year] = {
                nat_k: int(round(v_thousands * 1000))
                for nat_k, v_thousands in nat_vals.items()
            }

    return result


INE_PENSIONERS_CSV_URLS = (
    "https://www.ine.es/jaxi/files/tpx/es/csv_bdsc/48951.csv",
    "https://www.ine.es/jaxi/files/tpx/csv_bdsc/48951.csv",
)


def fetch_ine_pensioner_headcounts() -> dict[str, dict[str, int]]:
    """
    Descarga directamente el CSV semicolon-delimited de la Tabla 48951 del INE
    y extrae el número de pensionistas contributivos por nacionalidad (española vs. extranjera).
    """
    print("\n[2/4] 🌐 Descargando pensionistas contributivos por nacionalidad (INE Tabla 48951)...")

    for csv_url in INE_PENSIONERS_CSV_URLS:
        try:
            csv_resp = fetch(csv_url, allow_404=True)
            if csv_resp is None:
                continue
            parsed = parse_ine_pensioners_csv(decode_text_bytes(csv_resp.content))
            if parsed:
                print(
                    f"      ✓ INE Tabla 48951 decodificada: {len(parsed)} años obtenidos "
                    f"({min(parsed)}–{max(parsed)})."
                )
                return parsed
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"      ⚠️ Error leyendo CSV ({csv_url}): {exc}")

    print("      ⚠️ Advertencia: No se pudo extraer la Tabla 48951 del INE; continuando sin recuento de pensionistas por nacionalidad.")
    return {}
def parse_tgss_csv_text(text: str) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text), delimiter=";", quotechar='"'))
    if len(rows) < 3:
        raise ValueError(f"CSV de la TGSS demasiado corto ({len(rows)} filas).")

    header_index = None
    for idx, row in enumerate(rows[:10]):
        labels = [normalized_label(c).casefold() for c in row]
        if len(labels) >= 3 and labels[0] in {"período", "periodo"} and labels[1] in {"país", "pais"}:
            header_index = idx
            break

    if header_index is None:
        raise ValueError("No se encontró la fila de cabecera (Período;País;...) en el CSV de la TGSS.")

    headers = [normalized_label(c) for c in rows[header_index]]
    regime_columns = headers[2:]
    if not any("regimen" in h.casefold() or "régimen" in h.casefold() for h in regime_columns):
        raise ValueError(f"Columnas de régimen inesperadas en TGSS: {regime_columns}")

    periods_by_year: dict[str, dict[str, dict[str, dict[str, int | float]]]] = {}

    for line_num, row in enumerate(rows[header_index + 1 :], start=header_index + 2):
        if not row or not any(c.strip() for c in row):
            continue
        if len(row) != len(headers):
            raise ValueError(f"Fila {line_num} de TGSS tiene {len(row)} columnas (esperadas {len(headers)}).")

        raw_period = normalized_label(row[0])
        raw_country = normalized_label(row[1])
        if not raw_period or not raw_country:
            continue

        if re.fullmatch(r"\d{8}", raw_period):
            period_iso = datetime.strptime(raw_period, "%Y%m%d").date().isoformat()
            year = period_iso[:4]
        elif re.fullmatch(r"20\d{2}", raw_period):
            period_iso = raw_period
            year = raw_period
        else:
            continue

        if int(year) < START_YEAR:
            continue

        country_dict: dict[str, int | float] = {}
        for regime_label, raw_val in zip(regime_columns, row[2:]):
            val = parse_number(raw_val)
            if val is not None:
                clean_regime = re.sub(r"\s+TOTAL\s+SEXO$", "", regime_label, flags=re.I).strip()
                country_dict[clean_regime] = val

        if country_dict:
            periods_by_year.setdefault(year, {}).setdefault(period_iso, {})[raw_country] = country_dict

    if not periods_by_year:
        raise ValueError("El CSV de la TGSS no produjo registros numéricos válidos.")

    result_by_year: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for year, p_map in sorted(periods_by_year.items(), key=lambda kv: int(kv[0])):
        latest_period = max(p_map.keys())
        result_by_year[year] = {
            "referencePeriod": latest_period,
            "periodsAvailable": sorted(p_map.keys()),
            "affiliatesByCountryAndRegime": p_map[latest_period],
        }

    return result_by_year


def fetch_all_tgss_data() -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], str]:
    print("\n[3/4] 🌐 Descargando serie histórica de afiliados extranjeros de la TGSS...")

    try:
        meta_resp = fetch(TGSS_PXWEB_TABLE_URL)
        if meta_resp is not None:
            meta = meta_resp.json()
            variables = meta.get("variables", [])
            if variables:
                query_items = []
                for var in variables:
                    code = var["code"]
                    values = var.get("values", [])
                    if "sexo" in code.casefold():
                        total_vals = [
                            v for v, t in zip(values, var.get("valueTexts", []))
                            if "total" in t.casefold()
                        ]
                        selected = total_vals if total_vals else values
                    else:
                        selected = values
                    query_items.append({
                        "code": code,
                        "selection": {"filter": "item", "values": selected},
                    })

                px_payload = {
                    "query": query_items,
                    "response": {"format": "csv"},
                }
                csv_resp = fetch(TGSS_PXWEB_TABLE_URL, method="POST", json_body=px_payload)
                if csv_resp is not None:
                    parsed = parse_tgss_csv_text(decode_text_bytes(csv_resp.content))
                    print(f"      ✓ TGSS PX-Web API decodificada: {len(parsed)} años obtenidos.")
                    return parsed, TGSS_PORTAL_URL
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"      ⚠️ Consulta PX-Web API directa no disponible ({exc}); usando enlace oficial de consulta...")

    fallback_resp = fetch(TGSS_FALLBACK_CSV_URL)
    if fallback_resp is None:
        raise RuntimeError("No se pudo descargar el CSV oficial de la TGSS.")
    parsed = parse_tgss_csv_text(decode_text_bytes(fallback_resp.content))
    print(f"      ✓ TGSS CSV oficial decodificado: {len(parsed)} años obtenidos.")
    return parsed, TGSS_FALLBACK_CSV_URL


def build_payload(
    aeat_by_year: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    tgss_by_year: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    ine_pensioners_by_year: dict[str, dict[str, int]],
    tgss_source_url: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    print("\n[4/4] ⚖️ Consolidando y validando registros administrativos...")
    all_years = sorted(
        set(aeat_by_year.keys()) | set(tgss_by_year.keys()) | set(ine_pensioners_by_year.keys()),
        key=int,
    )
    if not all_years:
        raise ValueError("No hay años disponibles para consolidar.")

    annual_records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    data_points: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for year in all_years:
        aeat_rec = aeat_by_year.get(year)
        tgss_rec = tgss_by_year.get(year)
        ine_pen_rec = ine_pensioners_by_year.get(year)

        if aeat_rec:
            for pop_key, nat_map in aeat_rec.items():
                for nat_key, sex_map in nat_map.items():
                    for sex_key, age_map in sex_map.items():
                        for age_label, metrics in age_map.items():
                            for m_name, m_val in metrics.items():
                                if m_val is None:
                                    continue
                                if not isinstance(m_val, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(m_val) or m_val < 0:
                                    raise ValueError(
                                        f"Valor corrupto o negativo en AEAT {year} {pop_key}/{nat_key}/{sex_key}/{age_label}: {m_name}={m_val}"
                                    )

            # Inyectar el número oficial de pensionistas por nacionalidad (INE Tabla 48951)
            # dejando los importes en None ya que la AEAT no desglosa cuantías por nacionalidad.
            if ine_pen_rec and "pensionRecipients" in aeat_rec:
                pen_map = aeat_rec["pensionRecipients"]
                for nat_k in ("spanish", "foreign"):
                    if nat_k in ine_pen_rec:
                        pen_map.setdefault(nat_k, {})["total"] = {
                            "Total": {
                                "recipients": ine_pen_rec[nat_k],
                                "paymentsPerPerson": None,
                                "averagePensionEur": None,
                                "totalPensionsEur": None,
                            }
                        }

        headline_foreign_affiliates: int | float | None = None
        if tgss_rec:
            aff_map = tgss_rec["affiliatesByCountryAndRegime"]
            for country, regimes in aff_map.items():
                for regime, count in regimes.items():
                    if not isinstance(count, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(count) or count < 0:
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"Valor corrupto o negativo en TGSS {year} {country}/{regime}: {count}"
                        )

            total_country = aff_map.get("TOTAL") or aff_map.get("Total")
            if total_country:
                for reg_name, val in total_country.items():
                    if "total" in reg_name.casefold():
                        headline_foreign_affiliates = val
                        break
                if headline_foreign_affiliates is None:
                    headline_foreign_affiliates = next(iter(total_country.values()), None)

        annual_records.append({
            "year": year,
            "aeat": aeat_rec,
            "tgss": tgss_rec,
            "ine": {
                "contributoryPensionersByNationality": ine_pen_rec,
            } if ine_pen_rec else None,
        })

        if headline_foreign_affiliates is not None:
            data_points.append({
                "year": year,
                "value": headline_foreign_affiliates,
            })

    if not data_points:
        raise ValueError("No se pudieron construir dataPoints cronológicos principales.")

    today_str = date.today().isoformat()
    aeat_years = sorted(aeat_by_year.keys(), key=int)
    tgss_years = sorted(tgss_by_year.keys(), key=int)
    ine_years = sorted(ine_pensioners_by_year.keys(), key=int)

    sources = [
        {
            "institution": "Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT)",
            "shortName": "AEAT",
            "title": "Mercado de trabajo y pensiones en las fuentes tributarias (Nacionalidad y Sexo)",
            "period": f"{aeat_years[0]}–{aeat_years[-1]}",
            "lastUpdated": today_str,
            "url": AEAT_PORTAL_URL,
        },
        {
            "institution": "Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS)",
            "shortName": "TGSS",
            "title": "Afiliados extranjeros a la Seguridad Social (último día del período por país y régimen)",
            "period": f"{tgss_years[0]}–{tgss_years[-1]}",
            "lastUpdated": today_str,
            "url": tgss_source_url,
        },
    ]

    if ine_years:
        sources.append({
            "institution": "Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE)",
            "shortName": "INE",
            "title": "Personas según situación en la Seguridad Social por nacionalidad (Pensión contributiva)",
            "tableId": INE_PENSIONERS_TABLE_ID,
            "period": f"{ine_years[0]}–{ine_years[-1]}",
            "lastUpdated": today_str,
            "url": INE_PENSIONERS_PORTAL_URL,
        })

    context_notes_es = [
        "Datos procedentes directamente de registros administrativos oficiales: declaraciones tributarias (Modelo 190 de la AEAT), ficheros de afiliación de la TGSS y cruce con la Seguridad Social del INE (Tabla 48951), sin imputaciones sintéticas.",
        "Las magnitudes de asalariados y perceptores de prestaciones por desempleo de la AEAT incluyen número de perceptores y retribuciones/prestaciones brutas anuales por nacionalidad.",
        "Dado que la AEAT no desglosa el importe económico de las pensiones por nacionalidad, el número total de pensionistas contributivos por nacionalidad (española vs. extranjera) se obtiene de la Tabla 48951 del INE (en miles redondeados a personas).",
        "Los datos de la TGSS corresponden al número de afiliados extranjeros en alta laboral el último día del período de referencia disponible para cada año.",
    ]

    return {
        "id": SLUG,
        "kind": "admin-registers-nationality",
        "category": "economy-employment",
        "valueFormat": "number",
        "lastUpdated": today_str,
        "dataPoints": data_points,
        "annualRecords": annual_records,
        "contextNotes": context_notes_es,
        "sources": sources,
    }


def run_pipeline() -> dict[str, Any]:
    aeat_by_year, _ = fetch_all_aeat_data()
    ine_pensioners_by_year = fetch_ine_pensioner_headcounts()
    tgss_by_year, tgss_url = fetch_all_tgss_data()
    payload = build_payload(aeat_by_year, tgss_by_year, ine_pensioners_by_year, tgss_url)

    es_data = {
        "question": "Registros oficiales de empleo, salarios, desempleo y pensiones por nacionalidad.",
        "unit": "afiliados extranjeros",
        "contextNotes": payload["contextNotes"],
        "sources": payload["sources"],
    }

    en_data = {
        "question": "Official administrative registers of employment, wages, unemployment, and pensions by nationality.",
        "unit": "foreign affiliates",
        "contextNotes": [
            "Data sourced directly from official Spanish administrative registers: tax withholding filings (AEAT Form 190), Social Security affiliation records (TGSS), and INE Social Security status cross-tabulations (Table 48951), without synthetic imputations.",
            "AEAT figures for salaried workers and unemployment benefit recipients report both headcounts and gross annual amounts by nationality.",
            "Because AEAT does not publish euro pension expenditure by nationality, contributory pensioner headcounts split by Spanish vs. foreign nationality are sourced from INE Table 48951.",
            "TGSS figures reflect foreign nationals actively registered with Social Security on the last day of the latest available reference period for each year.",
        ],
        "sources": payload["sources"],
    }

    publish_dataset(SLUG, payload, es_data, en_data)
    return payload


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        run_pipeline()
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"\n❌ ERROR CRÍTICO EN PIPELINE DE REGISTROS ADMINISTRATIVOS: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(1)

"""
Pruebas unitarias para el cliente Eurostat y el pipeline de Cuentas Públicas de España.
Utiliza unittest con fixtures sintéticos (sin llamadas de red en vivo).
"""

from pathlib import Path
import sys
import unittest

from eurostat_client import parse_jsonstat, EurostatDataset
from cuentas_publicas import build_cuentas_publicas_payload


class TestCuentasPublicas(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_parse_jsonstat_sparse_dict(self):
        payload = {
            "version": "2.0",
            "class": "dataset",
            "id": ["unit", "time"],
            "size": [2, 2],
            "dimension": {
                "unit": {
                    "category": {"index": {"MIO_EUR": 0, "PC_GDP": 1}}
                },
                "time": {
                    "category": {"index": {"2023": 0, "2024": 1}}
                }
            },
            "value": {
                "0": 100.5,
                "3": 45.2
            },
            "updated": "2026-10-21T12:00:00+0200"
        }
        ds = parse_jsonstat(payload, "test_ds")
        self.assertEqual(ds.code, "test_ds")
        self.assertEqual(ds.updated, "2026-10-21")
        self.assertEqual(len(ds.records), 2)
        self.assertEqual(ds.records[0], {"unit": "MIO_EUR", "time": "2023", "value": 100.5})
        self.assertEqual(ds.records[1], {"unit": "PC_GDP", "time": "2024", "value": 45.2})

    def test_parse_jsonstat_dense_list(self):
        payload = {
            "version": "2.0",
            "class": "dataset",
            "id": ["na_item", "time"],
            "size": [1, 3],
            "dimension": {
                "na_item": {
                    "category": {"index": ["TR"]}
                },
                "time": {
                    "category": {"index": ["2022", "2023", "2024"]}
                }
            },
            "value": [500.0, None, 600.0],
            "updated": "2026-10-21T12:00:00"
        }
        ds = parse_jsonstat(payload, "test_dense")
        self.assertEqual(len(ds.records), 2)
        self.assertEqual(ds.records[0], {"na_item": "TR", "time": "2022", "value": 500.0})
        self.assertEqual(ds.records[1], {"na_item": "TR", "time": "2024", "value": 600.0})

    def test_reconciliation_passes_and_computes_residual(self):
        config = {
            "indicatorId": "cuentas-publicas-espana",
            "category": "economy-employment",
            "question": "¿Test pregunta?",
            "chartType": "fiscal-balance",
            "headlineUnit": "% del PIB",
            "geo": "ES",
            "sector": "S13",
            "startYear": 2015,
            "units": [
                {"id": "MIO_EUR", "label": "Millones de €", "decimals": 1},
                {"id": "PC_GDP", "label": "% del PIB", "decimals": 2}
            ],
            "taxonomy": {"revenues": [], "expenditures": []},
            "sources": [
                {"datasetKey": "aggregates", "institution": "Inst A", "shortName": "A", "title": "T1", "url": "https://example.com/1"},
                {"datasetKey": "expenditures", "institution": "Inst B", "shortName": "B", "title": "T2", "url": "https://example.com/2"},
                {"datasetKey": "revenues", "institution": "Inst C", "shortName": "C", "title": "T3", "url": "https://example.com/3"},
                {"datasetKey": None, "institution": "Inst D", "shortName": "D", "title": "T4", "url": "https://example.com/4"}
            ]
        }

        years = [str(y) for y in range(2015, 2025)]

        main_recs = []
        tax_recs = []
        exp_recs = []

        for y in years:
            main_recs.extend([
                {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": "MIO_EUR", "time": y, "na_item": "TR", "value": 500000.0},
                {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": "MIO_EUR", "time": y, "na_item": "TE", "value": 550000.0},
                {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": "MIO_EUR", "time": y, "na_item": "B9", "value": -50000.0},
                {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": "PC_GDP", "time": y, "na_item": "TR", "value": 40.0},
                {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": "PC_GDP", "time": y, "na_item": "TE", "value": 44.0},
                {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": "PC_GDP", "time": y, "na_item": "B9", "value": -4.0},
            ])
            tax_recs.extend([
                {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": "MIO_EUR", "time": y, "na_item": "D2", "value": 150000.0},
                {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": "MIO_EUR", "time": y, "na_item": "D5", "value": 120000.0},
                {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": "MIO_EUR", "time": y, "na_item": "D61", "value": 180000.0},
                {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": "MIO_EUR", "time": y, "na_item": "D91", "value": 5000.0},
                {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": "PC_GDP", "time": y, "na_item": "D2", "value": 12.0},
                {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": "PC_GDP", "time": y, "na_item": "D5", "value": 9.6},
                {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": "PC_GDP", "time": y, "na_item": "D61", "value": 14.4},
                {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": "PC_GDP", "time": y, "na_item": "D91", "value": 0.4},
            ])
            for i in range(1, 11):
                fcode = f"GF0{i}" if i < 10 else "GF10"
                exp_recs.extend([
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": "MIO_EUR", "time": y, "cofog99": fcode, "value": 55000.0},
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": "PC_GDP", "time": y, "cofog99": fcode, "value": 4.4},
                ])
            exp_recs.extend([
                {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": "MIO_EUR", "time": y, "cofog99": "TOTAL", "value": 550000.0},
                {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": "PC_GDP", "time": y, "cofog99": "TOTAL", "value": 44.0},
            ])

        ds_main = EurostatDataset(code="gov_10a_main", updated="2026-10-21", records=main_recs)
        ds_tax = EurostatDataset(code="gov_10a_taxag", updated="2026-10-21", records=tax_recs)
        ds_exp = EurostatDataset(code="gov_10a_exp", updated="2026-10-21", records=exp_recs)

        payload = build_cuentas_publicas_payload(config, ds_main, ds_tax, ds_exp)

        self.assertEqual(len(payload["annualBalances"]), 10)
        self.assertEqual(len(payload["dataPoints"]), 10)
        b2024 = payload["annualBalances"][-1]
        self.assertEqual(b2024["year"], "2024")
        self.assertEqual(b2024["metrics"]["MIO_EUR"]["totals"]["balance"], -50000.0)
        self.assertEqual(b2024["metrics"]["MIO_EUR"]["revenues"]["NON_TAX_RESIDUAL"]["total"], 45000.0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""
Pruebas unitarias para el pipeline de Indicadores de Nacionalidad y Origen (Factor.es).
Ejecución offline con fixtures sintéticos sin llamadas de red.
"""

import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import unittest

from eurostat_client import EurostatDataset
from indicadores_nacionalidad import (
    build_nationality_indicators_payload,
    validate_concept_guide,
)


def make_mock_datasets(years: list[str], corrupt_unemp: bool = False, corrupt_income: bool = False, omit_latest_lag: bool = False) -> dict[str, EurostatDataset]:
    pop_ctz_recs = []
    pop_birth_recs = []
    emp_ctz_recs = []
    emp_birth_recs = []
    act_ctz_recs = []
    act_birth_recs = []
    empr_ctz_recs = []
    empr_birth_recs = []
    unemp_ctz_recs = []
    unemp_birth_recs = []
    acq_recs = []
    inc_ctz_recs = []
    inc_tot_recs = []
    pov_ctz_recs = []
    pov_tot_recs = []

    for idx, y in enumerate(years):
        for group in ["TOTAL", "NAT", "FOR"]:
            if group == "TOTAL":
                tot, u15, w64, s65 = 40000000.0, 6000000.0, 25800000.0, 8200000.0
            elif group == "NAT":
                tot, u15, w64, s65 = 35000000.0, 5000000.0, 22000000.0, 8000000.0
            else:
                tot, u15, w64, s65 = 5000000.0, 1000000.0, 3800000.0, 200000.0

            pop_ctz_recs.extend([
                {"time": y, "citizen": group, "age": "TOTAL", "value": tot},
                {"time": y, "citizen": group, "age": "Y_LT15", "value": u15},
                {"time": y, "citizen": group, "age": "Y15-64", "value": w64},
                {"time": y, "citizen": group, "age": "Y_GE65", "value": s65},
            ])
            pop_birth_recs.extend([
